explication: Pi Web is a local browser workspace for using the pi coding agent. A user selects or creates a project session, reads its transcript, submits agent turns, and receives streamed events and tool results; they can also browse project files and Git changes. The browser UI talks to Next.js API routes, which coordinate agent RPC, session files, project access, and configuration. Separate capability branches cover models and provider credentials, plugins and skills, subagents, terminals, worktrees, and authentication. Connections are limited to README-documented workflows and sampled caller references; unsampled route internals are not inferred.
